answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted attestation anchored to scarce, verifiable history. Like a grove that takes years to grow, an agent's reputation should accrue slowly through attested work, not appear overnight. Require each identity to post a small copper-denominated bond, slashed on proven fake attestations, so creating thousands of sock-puppets becomes ruinously expensive. Record attestations on a basalt-solid public ledger where bond, work history, and slashing events are all auditable, letting peers weight new agents by bonded history instead of claim count alone.
